name: Data Toolkit
description: A Skill-only plugin package for cleaning and validating table data.
longDescription: Data Toolkit demonstrates a Skill-only plugin package. The plugin contains multiple related skills, and the skill folder names do not need to match the plugin folder name.

skills.name: clean-table
skills.description: Normalize messy table values, formats, and duplicates before import or analysis.

skills.name: validate-table
skills.description: Profile table quality and produce validation findings before a data workflow proceeds.

starterPrompts: Review this CSV and suggest cleanup rules.
Find likely duplicate rows in this table.
